test_shuffle_table: test the shuffle_table function to verify it shuffles PyArrow table rows deterministically with a seeded random state
test_apply_filter: test the apply_filter function to drop null rows and apply PyArrow dataset filter expressions on a table
test_filter_strings_by_length: test the filter_strings_by_length function to drop rows where any string in a list column falls outside min and max length bounds
test_filter_list_by_range: test the filter_list_by_range function to drop rows where any numeric value in a list column falls outside min and max value bounds
test_concat_table: test the concat_table function to concatenate multiple PyArrow tables with an option to combine chunks into a single chunk
